arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالْأَدَاءُ.
transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee ahlika wa maalik, innamaa jazaa'us-salafil-hamdu wal'adaa'.
translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. Surely, the reward for a loan is praise and repayment.
reference: An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 300, Ibn Majah 2/809
